# Read in the flight data

## Question 4:

### Using the flight data, complete the following:

- Create training and test data using `train_test_split` with the following arguments; `test_size = .33` and `random_state = 1936`.
- Use `GradientBoostingClassifier()` to build a machine learning model.
- Report your accuracy score and confusion matrix.

```{python}
# Question 4 Code

flights

# Clean data
numeric_cols = flights.select(cs.numeric()).columns
numeric_cols.append("num_of_delays_carrier")

# Cast delays_carrier to i64 and fill nulls with median or mean
cleaned_df = (flights
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False)
  )
  .with_columns([
    pl.when(pl.col(col) < 0)
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(col))
    .alias(col)
    for col in numeric_cols
  ])
  # Fill minutes with median, num of with mean, and year with median
  .with_columns(
    cs.starts_with("minutes_delayed").fill_null(cs.starts_with("minutes_delayed").median())
  )
  .with_columns(
    cs.starts_with("num_of").fill_null(cs.starts_with("num_of").mean())
  )
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("year").fill_null(pl.col("year").median())
  )
)

cleaned_df
```

```{python}
# Remove bad columns
x = cleaned_df.select(cs.exclude("airport_name", "month", "airport_code"))

# What are we supposed to be predicting? I have no clue so I will say airport_code
y = cleaned_df.select("airport_code")

# Split training data and seed randomness
x_train, x_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(x, y, test_size=0.33, random_state=1936)


```

```{python}
# Make gradient boosting
gb = GradientBoostingClassifier()
gb.fit(x_train, y_train)
```

```{python}
# GB prediction
gb_pred = gb.predict(x_test)

# GB classification report
print("Gradient Boosting")
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_test, gb_pred) * 100:.3f}%")
print("Confusion Matrix:")
print(confusion_matrix(y_test, gb_pred))
print("Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(y_test, gb_pred))
```
